name: cmux
description: cmux terminal control bundle: vendored user-facing skills that teach agents to drive and configure the cmux macOS terminal via its socket CLI -- topology and routing (windows, workspaces, panes, surfaces), customization, settings, socket policy, Ghostty rendering config, keyboard shortcuts, diagnostics, and shared behavior. Contributor skills (architecture, backend, release, testing) are omitted. Third-party (manaflow-ai/cmux publishes no APM/marketplace manifest); referenced as raw GitHub skill paths, same pattern as the other external bundles.
